content.title: Creation vs editing — two paths, one engine
Path A: Edit existing
content.subtitle: Instruction-based mutation
content.body: Open any PPTX/DOCX. Replace text with fit-checked overflow. Swap images with fill/crop/contain. Extract brand profiles. Non-destructive style preservation. Every edit is an instruction object — replayable, auditable, undoable.

content.title: Path B: Generate from scratch
content.subtitle: Declarative JSON vocabulary
content.body: No template file required. Strict JSON Schema with loud, actionable validation. AI-consumable: 12 concepts, ~200 tokens in a prompt. Exact Typst preview by construction — the layout pass is shared.

content.title: The generation pipeline
content.subtitle: JSON → Parse → Expand → Layout → Emit → PPTX + Preview

content.title: 1. Parse
content.subtitle: JSON Schema + Validator
content.body: Single-pass System.Text.Json walker. 53 adversarial rejection cases. CSS-isms, typos, percentages all caught with path + 'Did you mean…?' suggestions.

content.title: 2. Expand
content.subtitle: Archetypes + Components
content.body: 5 archetype slide types, 8 prebuilt components. Archetypes compose components, components emit primitives. Never a second layout system.

content.title: 3. Layout
content.subtitle: Pure C# resolver
content.body: Row, column, grid. 5 justify modes. Grow/aspect/padding. Text measurement with shrink/error overflow. Zero OOXML or Typst imports — resolved once.

content.title: 4. Emit
content.subtitle: OOXML + Typst dual path
content.body: One draw tree, two emitters. OOXML for delivery (native PPTX). Typst for preview (#place-only). Parity via per-primitive RMSE thresholds.

children.text: "Layout is resolved exactly once, in C#."
Typst is a dumb renderer. The draw tree feeds both emitters. No second layout pass.

content.title: By design
content.subtitle: Components ARE primitives
content.body: Every component expands to a pure primitive tree — rect, text, ellipse, line. No direct OOXML. No escape hatches. Enforceable by inspection and enforced by test.

content.title: Crop mode
content.subtitle: Center-crop with source rect. Fills container, preserves aspect, crops excess.

content.title: Contain mode
content.subtitle: Entire image visible, letterboxed. No cropping, no distortion.

content.title: Fill mode
content.subtitle: Stretches to fill container exactly. Distorts if the aspect ratios differ.

content.title: Generation power
content.subtitle: Brand extraction · Text fitting · Image modes · Archetype slides

content.title: TextFitService
content.subtitle: Shrink, never clip
content.body: Font metrics-driven text measurement. normAutofit emulation. fontScale ≥ MinScale or loud warning. Overflow policy per container: error, shrink, or clip. Never silently loses content.

content.title: Image fit modes (F7)
content.subtitle: Fill · Contain · Crop
content.body: Source-rect crop geometry. Proportional contain scaling. Cover-style fill with center-crop. Used by every image_card in this deck — every image here runs through the F7 pipeline.

content.title: BrandProfileExtractor
content.subtitle: Mine tokens from existing decks
content.body: Run on pres-pro, AetherLink, FusionFest, REMOVED. Extracts palette, fonts, and metrics. Hand-tuned into shippable token sets. Design tokens are first-class input — the generator is beautiful by default because great brands were loaded first.
